newsitem.title: USA: N. American Vaccine could disappoint -- report.
newsitem.headline: N. American Vaccine could disappoint -- report.

text.p: North American Vaccine Inc may not be able to meet bullish Wall Street expectations even if it secures regulatory approval of its vaccine for diphtheria, tetanus and whooping cough, according to financial weekly Barron's.
The paper cited rosy forecasts from the company in the past which have yet to crystallize and competition from SmithKline Beecham Plc and Rhone-Poulenc.

It also said North American's $600 million market capitalization is larger than the entire U.S. market for whooping cough vaccine, estimated at about $200 million, and the world market, which might be an added $200 million.
